principle: Low visual complexity is the strongest lever on how appealing a page feels at a glance.
detect: Several equal-weight elements in the first viewport: pills, badges, trust rows, multiple buttons, icon rows.
fix: Remove or demote everything that is not the headline, the subhead and one action.

source.title: The role of visual complexity and prototypicality regarding first impression of websites
source.author: Tuch et al. (2012)
